name: prompt-1115
image_vibe: Soft playful tsundere studio portrait with a side glance and clean pink backdrop
image_purpose: Create a photorealistic social-style portrait edit while preserving the approved adult subject's identity and styling.

prompt.project_info: A photorealistic edit using the required approved-adult person reference, changing only expression, subtle head angle, gaze, light body language, and background.
prompt.main_subject: The adult person from the required approved-adult reference photo. Keep the same face, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle including color, bangs, length, and volume, outfit, accessories, gender presentation, and overall likeness unchanged. Give the subject a light tsundere expression with slightly averted gaze, a tiny eyebrow raise, gently pressed lips or a small pout, a restrained almost-smile, and shy pride rather than anger.
prompt.composition_elements: Torso slightly turned away as if avoiding the camera, eyes glancing back in a side-eye, one hand making a gentle half-hearted stop gesture near the chest without grabbing the phone, face in sharp focus, and a solid pink seamless studio background with optional subtle gradient.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Clean soft studio realism, even flattering light, gentle facial modeling, quiet playful sweetness beneath mock annoyance, and a simple pink environment.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic portrait edit, moderate wide-to-normal perspective, sharp face focus, realistic skin and hand texture, high-resolution clarity, no text, watermark, frame, extra fingers, or deformed limbs.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic edit using the required approved-adult person reference photo. Keep the same face, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle including color, bangs, length, and volume, outfit, accessories, gender presentation, and overall likeness unchanged; do not face-swap or create a new person. Change only the expression, subtle head angle, gaze, light body language, and background. Give the adult subject a light tsundere expression: slightly averted gaze, tiny eyebrow raise, gently pressed lips or a small pout, barely-there restrained smirk, and shy pride beneath the mock annoyance, not real anger or hostility. Turn the torso slightly away as if avoiding the camera, glance back with side-eye, and make one hand perform a gentle half-hearted stop gesture near the chest without grabbing the phone. Keep the face in sharp focus and replace the background with a solid pink seamless studio backdrop with an optional subtle gradient. Use clean soft studio realism, realistic skin and hand texture, and no text, watermark, frame, extra fingers, or deformed limbs.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identity drift, face swap, changed outfit, hostile rage, aggressive gesture, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, deformed limbs, plastic skin, heavy blur, text, watermark, frame

assets.name: approved adult identity and styling reference
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult subject's face, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, outfit, accessories, gender presentation, and overall likeness exactly while changing only expression, pose, gaze, and background.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the approved adult reference. Keep identity, hair, outfit, and accessories unchanged; only the tsundere expression, subtle turn/side-eye, gentle stop gesture, and pink seamless background may change.
